phase3_findings.description: The sed runnability probe compiles only s/x/x/, so a reduced sed that cannot handle a group with alternation and an interval passes the probe and then fails through the per-payload message.
The new assertions capture stdout only, so the scrub's success-path exit 0 is never asserted.
The contract header's PORTABLE paragraph credits per-letter matching to the header name only and does not mention the scheme keyword.

fix_decisions.claim_text: the sed runnability probe is weaker than the rules it gates
fix_decisions.evidence: the probe predates this change and the fail direction is closed either way (nothing is emitted); strengthening it is a separate concern from #1915

parking_evidence.basis: pre-existing probe, not touched by this diff, and it fails closed
parking_evidence.failing_input: a reduced sed that compiles s/x/x/ but not a group with an interval

fix_decisions.claim_text: the assertions do not assert exit 0
fix_decisions.evidence: the helper fails closed by emitting nothing, so a non-zero exit already makes each byte-comparison assertion RED; a separate exit-code assertion adds no discriminating signal

fix_decisions.claim_text: the header does not mention per-letter scheme matching
fix_decisions.evidence: the header paragraph is not diff-modified and is true as written; the prohibition against narrowing the scheme keyword is already stated once, at the rule site, and restating it in the header would duplicate it across comments

parking_evidence.basis: the prohibition is already single-sourced at the rule site
parking_evidence.failing_input: a future edit narrowing the scheme keyword to a case-sensitive tail

verification_evidence.focused_selection: scripts/scrub-credentials.sh and lib/test/run.sh are both run.sh-resident (coverage-map owner: unmodularized), so the covering instrument is lib/test/run-shard.sh monolith; lib/test/modules/review-trigger-helpers.sh is the covering module for the dependent #409 scrub fixture. Both ran green after the fix: monolith 9906 passed / 0 failed / 1 skipped (the dirty-tree #434 self-scan), review-trigger-helpers 844 passed / 0 failed. single_flight_consulted: no.

prompt_addenda: the shadow substituted a direct 10-claim adversarial verification matrix for the Phase 1/1.5/2 checklist subagent dispatches; recorded so the 10-passed tally is not read as a full agent-checklist run

phase3_findings.description: A lone raw backslash now ends the token match everywhere, not only before a closing quote, so a token containing a raw backslash leaks its tail; the trade is right but the changeset discloses only the closing-quote case.
The four-unit floor is a genuine blocklist relaxation for one-to-three-unit runs, pinned as intended by two new assertions; it sits at the shortest realistic base64 basic-auth payload.
The SHAPES variable is the header-declared single source of truth for consumer caveat wording and no longer reflects the floor, while the disclosure lives in the changeset.
The floor is a length heuristic, so a recorded perl -pe substitution of the header is still consumed; origin/main corrupts that same input identically, so it is pre-existing rather than a regression.
No assertion pins which side of the lone-backslash trade the helper is on, and no fixture covers the header-object JSON shape a real transcript emits.
